findings.summary: V5 is violated and V1/V2 are zero-power: the vi.mock factory replaces spawnGenerateRole with a hand-written reimplementation, so the primary assertions never touch production code. test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:45-70 defines a local spawnGenerateRole that duplicates the body of src/generate.ts:263-288 (writeInputFile, serializeCorpusToPositional, tmpdir prompt file, buildGenerateRoleArgv, spawnProcess, readBody, rmSync) and returns it as the module export at line 75. Every V1 (line 134, 155), V2 (line 176, 178) and V5-a (line 275) call resolves to this test-authored copy, not to the real spawnGenerateRole. Decisive proof of zero power: if src/generate.ts:217-227 were changed to emit '--route', the mock's buildGenerateRoleArgv wrapper (line 34-43) would forward that mutated argv, but the real intra-module call site at src/generate.ts:275 is never exercised by this file at all — and if src/generate.ts:263-288 itself were deleted or made to drop --prompt-file, every V1/V2/V5-a assertion would still pass, because the test supplies its own implementation. Spec §2 V5 requires assertions to be driven by production assembly and explicitly disqualifies self-built injection ('⛔ 自建 runtime 注入不算数'); a self-built copy of the production function under test is a stronger form of the same disqualification.

W1 and W2 remain fabricated rather than applied to production code, so V1/V2 are unguarded under spec §3 ('⛔ 杀不掉即判 V1 零功率'). The mutation is injected by the mock wrapper at test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:34-43, which splices '--route' onto whatever actual.buildGenerateRoleArgv returns. Because the splice is unconditional on the real return value, the W1 assertions (lines 325-326, 348) and W2 assertions (lines 367, 383, 402-404) are true-by-construction: they would remain green even if the real buildGenerateRoleArgv at src/generate.ts:217-227 already emitted '--route', which is precisely the regression W1 is supposed to detect. A mutation that cannot distinguish a correct production function from the defective one it replaces demonstrates nothing about the power of the V-guards. This is the third restyling of the identical blocker recorded in rf-attempt_01KZMJP1Z1EV942SZKQH17MJDA (test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:242-269) and rf-attempt_01KZMM4JV4MC57W0B4J0N95JBE (test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:27-53).

W3 asserts against a test-fabricated object rather than production state, so V3 has no mutation coverage. The mock's DEFAULT_GENERATE_CONFIG getter (test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:76-86) synthesizes a config by spreading route: 'dummy' onto each debater and the synthesizer and adding exportRoute: 'export'. The W3 tests then assert that Object.keys of that same synthesized object contain 'route' (lines 417-418, 421-422) and 'exportRoute' (lines 427-428) — asserting that an object contains the keys the test itself just added. This observes nothing about the real DEFAULT_GENERATE_CONFIG at src/generate.ts:42-49; the assertions would pass unchanged whether or not the production dead fields were actually removed. The dev-note's claim at docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g8_role_argv_01.md:79 that 'V3 守卫 toEqual(["role"]) 和 not.toContain("exportRoute") 会挂' is therefore not established by the committed tests, violating spec §4.4 item 2 ('⛔ 不得编造失败现象').

The dev-note's V7 narrative misstates what the committed tests do, which spec §4.4 item 2 forbids. Lines 71-73 assert '变异可达生产调用路径' and that 'spawnGenerateRole 在 mock 中调用 mocked buildGenerateRoleArgv，因此变异可到达 spawnProcess 记录的 argv——即 V1/V2/V5 断言所观测的生产调用路径'. The mocked spawnGenerateRole is not a production call path: it is a test-file reimplementation (test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:45-70) that shadows src/generate.ts:263-288 entirely. The W1 row at line 77 further claims the mutation is observed through the production entry ('W1 测试通过 spawnGenerateRole → 假 spawn 记录 argv'), when the entry exercised is the mock. The note thus reports a mutation-kill result that the committed evidence does not support.

V6 evidence is internally inconsistent with the Continuous record of the immediately preceding attempt and cannot be reconciled from the tree. The dev-note pastes 'Test Files 29 passed (29) / Tests 512 passed (512)' at lines 63-64, while rc-attempt_01KZMM4JV4MC57W0B4J0N95JBE records the same package's tail as 'Test Files 29 passed (29) / Tests 513 passed (513)'. No product change between those attempts is documented that would remove exactly one test, and the dev-note's change list (lines 24-36) claims 20 tests in test/g8-role-argv.test.ts while the committed file contains 19 it() bodies (V1 x2, V2 x4, V3 x4, V4 x2, V5 x2, W1 x2, W2 x2, W3 x2, counted at lines 126, 147, 167, 195, 201, 208, 214, 229, 253, 267, 285, 314, 333, 357, 387, 414, 425). Both counts still clear the 28/498 baseline, so this is not by itself disqualifying, but the pasted tail does not match the package it claims to describe.

The production implementation itself is correct and is not the reason for this REJECT. buildGenerateRoleArgv emits exactly agentRunBin / --role / --run-id / --input / --prompt-file with no --route or --runtime (src/generate.ts:210-228); GenerateRoleSpec carries only role (src/generate.ts:32-34); GenerateConfig has only debaters and synthesizer with exportRoute removed (src/generate.ts:37-49); assertDistinctDebaterRoutes is gone and a repository-wide search finds no dangling route references in src/generate.ts; the four-row role/runtime/route table required by spec §6 is recorded both in the JSDoc (src/generate.ts:24-31) and the dev-note (lines 13-18); and triage argv is untouched. A remediation should preserve all of this and confine itself to making the V-guards and the W1-W3 matrix observe the real src/generate.ts exports instead of test-authored substitutes.
